precheck.query: select (select count(*) from public.receivables) as receivable_rows, (select coalesce(sum(bill_amount),0) from public.receivables) as receivable_bill_total, (select count(*) from public.receivable_payments) as payment_rows, (select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from public.receivable_payments where verification_status = 'confirmed' and reversed_at is null) as effective_confirmed_collected;

forwardFixStrategy: If the SQL Editor reports any error, stop release. Inspect the live schema and function definitions read-only, identify the last successfully created additive object, and prepare a reviewed forward-only SQL artifact for only the missing or incorrect delta. Do not blindly rerun the complete migration, remove business rows, or mutate applied migrations 001-044. Prefer forward repair over dropping the nullable link; any rollback that could affect linked rows requires a new owner-authorized plan.
